Vendored runtime dependencies
=============================

Shelfwatch serves this interface from disk only. Nothing here is fetched at
run time; the page works with the network disabled.

three.min.js
  Upstream: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.128.0/build/three.min.js
  Version:  three.js r128 (0.128.0)
  Licence:  MIT — Copyright 2010-2021 Three.js Authors (SPDX: MIT)
  Upstream licence header is retained at the top of the file.

OrbitControls.js
  Upstream: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.128.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js
  Version:  three.js r128 (0.128.0), non-module example build
  Licence:  MIT — Copyright 2010-2021 Three.js Authors (SPDX: MIT)
  Registers THREE.OrbitControls on the global THREE object created by
  three.min.js.

Both files are unmodified copies of the upstream builds. Three.js also carries
its own licence text upstream at
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r128/LICENSE.
